title: CNNs predict age and sex from fundus images in hypertension, diabetes and smoking
summary: CNN models trained on 219,302 fundus images of healthy participants predicted age with R2 0.92 and mean absolute error 3.06 years in normal test images. Errors were similar in hypertension (3.46 years), diabetes (3.55) and smokers (2.65), but R2 was lower (0.74, 0.75 and 0.86), and sex prediction had AUC above 0.96. The authors interpret this as ageing and vascular changes having different retinal features; the data come from one archive, so this is suggestive.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural networks predicting age and sex from retinal fundus images
organization: Seoul National University; Seoul National University Bundang Hospital; Kangdong Sacred Heart Hospital

evidence.tested: Four held-out test sets: 24,366 normal, 40,659 hypertension, 14,189 diabetes and 113,510 smoker images.
evidence.unknown: Independent-site validation; causal interpretation of ageing versus vascular change; full text not reviewed beyond a methods excerpt.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts age and sex to compare normal ageing with vascular changes
